name: Mortis (Grave's Decay) — 2 Intermediate — Corrupt the Undead Flesh

system.description:
You can infect a victim with a contagious mystical disease that merges the states of life, death and undeath. Mortals can contract this disease merely by being near one already affected; Cainites must drink the victim's blood to be infected.

You must be able to see your victim. Spend a Willpower Trait and perform a challenge of your Mental Traits against your target's Physical Traits. If you win, your target is infected.

Infected Cainites lose one-quarter of their Mental and Physical Traits (round up) and spend two Blood Traits instead of one at the beginning of each night; they must win a Static Self-Control/Instinct Challenge (difficulty three Traits) each time they feed or vomit back all the blood ingested without benefit. Infected mortals lose one-quarter of their Mental and Physical Traits (round up), take a level of lethal damage each night, and cannot hold down food.

At sunset each evening, the victim may attempt to throw off the disease with a Static Physical Challenge (difficulty seven Traits); three cumulative successes conquer the disease, after which Traits return at one per hour.
